message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards applied to the loaded IAGA, OMNI, or Wiemer data anywhere in the visible code paths.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local file paths (e.g., 'data_local/iaga/2013/', 'data_local/omni/sw_data.h5') with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads cached data and scalers via pickle without any hash, signature, or integrity verification, and no pretrained model weights are loaded with any integrity check.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates label distributions, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or manual FGSM/PGD attack implementation anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/val/test splits are created, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and the overfit flag allows test_idx to be set equal to train_idx, undermining isolation; no multiple independent metrics or tamper-protection mechanism is present.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model during inference.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference path contains no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on model outputs before they are returned or used downstream.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a geomagnetic field prediction model using GRU/spherical harmonics, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
